lines.text: Many learners say: I will see you in the next Friday.
Better: I will see you next Friday.
We do not use in the.
The first! I will see you next Friday.

data.wrong: I will see you in the next Friday.
data.right: I will see you next Friday.
data.why: We do not use in the.

options: I will see you next Friday.

native.tip: Em português dizemos “na próxima sexta”; em inglês, diga só “next Friday”, sem “in the”.
native.caption: Você também diz isso? “I will see you in the next Friday.” 😅 O certo é “I will see you next Friday.” Em português dizemos “na próxima sexta”; em inglês, diga só “next Friday”, sem “in the”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “I will see you next Friday.” Agora diga em voz alta “I will see you next Friday.” e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: In Portuguese we say “na próxima sexta”; in English, just say “next Friday”, without “in the”.
en.caption: Do you say this too? “I will see you in the next Friday.” 😅 The right way is “I will see you next Friday.” In Portuguese we say “na próxima sexta”; in English, just say “next Friday”, without “in the”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
